description.value: Screamers Ice Cream Cafe is a retro-inspired ice cream and cafe destination on the main street of Radium Hot Springs, family-owned and operated for over 25 years and recently renovated with a modern vintage aesthetic. The menu spans classic scoops, banana splits, affogatos made with Oso Negro espresso from Nelson BC, crepes, acai bowls, breakfast sandwiches, gluten-free baked goods, and smoothies. Owned by the Palashniuk family — Radium locals who also operate The Gateway Motel — it serves as a community gathering spot and a natural road-trip stop for anyone passing through the Columbia Valley.
